examples.title: Midnight Gaming Room
examples.prompt: Create one cinematic anime digital painting in a landscape 16:9 composition. Malfoid is a 25-year-old adult woman with long platinum-blonde hair, emerald eyes, and black hoop earrings. She wears a white collared shirt, a green-and-silver striped tie, and a black robe with emerald lining and an embroidered serpent crest. From a high diagonal viewpoint above her left shoulder, show her seated in a black gaming chair, hands resting naturally on a blue-backlit keyboard, turning her face upward toward the viewer with a quiet, absorbed expression. Black headphones rest around her neck. A large monitor occupies the right side and shows a moonlit castle romance between a platinum-haired adult woman and a dark-haired adult man with glasses. Layer the dark collector's room with stacked magical books, pinned monochrome pictures, serpent emblems, a black mug, a notebook, a controller, small figurines, and a candle. Cool blue screen light reveals her face and fine hair strands; tiny warm candle highlights punctuate deep charcoal and forest-green shadows. Use refined anime facial drawing, softly painted skin, detailed fabric, and rich overlapping foreground and background objects. Place a small @PLAyfORGE signature at the bottom left.

examples.title: Aqua Magic Poster
examples.prompt: Create one luminous anime character poster in a portrait 4:7 composition against a clean pale-mint background. Malfoid is a 25-year-old adult woman with flowing platinum-blonde hair, emerald eyes, and black hoop earrings. She sits in a twisting three-quarter pose and looks back over her shoulder with a confident, playful smile. Dress her in a white collared shirt, a fitted charcoal knit vest, a green-and-silver striped tie, a charcoal pleated skirt, black thigh-high stockings, and a loose black robe with emerald lining and an embroidered serpent crest. Arrange the robe and long hair in sweeping diagonals. Her raised open palm supports a floating transparent aqua sphere containing a silver four-point star; thin rings of water and distinct suspended droplets orbit it. Use precise anime linework, translucent glasslike highlights, luminous strands of hair, soft skin gradients, and crisp fabric folds. The face, hand, and magical sphere form a clear triangular focal arrangement. Set the word Malfoid in large dark-green gothic lettering at the upper right, and place a small @PLAyfORGE signature at the bottom right.

examples.title: Emerald Eyes in Cold Light
examples.prompt: Create one cinematic cel-shaded anime portrait in a vertical 4:7 composition. Frame Malfoid, a 25-year-old adult woman, tightly from the upper chest to just above her head, facing directly toward the viewer. Long platinum-blonde hair parts around her forehead and falls down both sides of her face; black hoop earrings sit beside her jaw. Her large emerald eyes are the sharpest focal point, with layered green irises and small clear catchlights. Draw the inner brows slightly raised and knitted, the lower eyelids subtly tense, and the lips barely parted to convey restrained worry and vulnerability. She wears a white collared shirt, a green-and-silver striped tie, and charcoal clothing with dark-green trim. Cool light from the upper left illuminates the hair and one side of her face, while broad, clean cel shadows shape the opposite cheek and neck. Use delicate outlines, restrained gradients, and a soft blue-gray background with almost no objects. Keep the composition intimate and centered. Place a small @PLAyfORGE signature at the bottom right.

examples.title: Cosplay and Sketchbook
examples.prompt: Create one natural photographic portrait in a vertical 9:16 composition. A 25-year-old adult woman portraying Malfoid sits in a personal art and collector's room. She has long loosely waved pale-blonde hair, pale green eyes, natural skin texture, subtle makeup, and dangling metallic earrings. She wears a white collared shirt, a green-and-silver striped tie, a fitted charcoal knit vest with green trim, a charcoal pleated skirt, dark stockings, and an open black robe with emerald lining. Frame her from the thighs upward at a seated eye-level viewpoint. She looks thoughtfully toward the right edge of the frame while holding an upright spiral sketchbook beside her face on the left side. The page contains a detailed black-and-white manga drawing of the same long-haired character in matching tie and vest, with pencil hatching and a confident expression. Keep the paper, hand grip, knit texture, and hair strands tangible. Behind her, include trailing plants, pinned monochrome pictures, a dark-green serpent banner, books, drawing tools, a warm desk lamp, and a monitor showing a distant castle. Combine soft window light with the warm lamp and a muted green, charcoal, cream, and beige palette. Place Mofoid with モフォイド beneath it in understated pale lettering at the upper right, and a small @94vanai signature near the lower right.
